name: output-budget-framing-v2
instruction: In `packages/agent/src/output-budget.ts`, export `MESSAGE_FRAMING_TOKENS` and charge a fixed allowance of at least five tokens once per locally counted message. Add framing after the existing 10% content-token margin, so framing itself is not padded. With a provider-reported prompt anchor, charge only messages after the anchor; without one, charge every context message. Preserve existing system/tool framing, absolute headway, minimum cap, and omit-default behavior.
